# University of Arkansas Online

> University of Arkansas Online offers online degrees and credentials from the University of Arkansas, an accredited public research university, including bachelor's, master's, and doctoral programs, as well as licensure, certificates, and microcredentials.

## Navigation Links

- [University of Arkansas Online](https://online.uark.edu): University of Arkansas Online offers online degrees and credentials from the University of Arkansas, an accredited public research university, including bachelor's, master's, and doctoral programs, as well as licensure, certificates, and microcredentials.
- [Programs](https://online.uark.edu/programs/): Explore 100+ flexible online degree programs at the University of Arkansas, including undergraduate, graduate, and certificate options. Advance your career today!
- [Courses](https://online.uark.edu/courses/): Enroll in University of Arkansas online courses with flexible registration, financial aid options, and expert support. Start your path to success today!
- [Students](https://online.uark.edu/students/): Discover flexible online learning at the University of Arkansas. Connect with faculty, peers, and resources while working toward your degree, wherever you are.
- [Resources](https://online.uark.edu/resources/): Explore student success resources at the University of Arkansas. Get support, tutoring, and guidance to excel in your online learning journey.
- [Paying for College](https://online.uark.edu/paying-for-college.php): Learn about scholarships, grants, and financial aid at the University of Arkansas. Apply for FAFSA and explore options to fund your online education.
- [Blog](https://online.uark.edu/blog/): Explore The Online Learner blog to learn about exciting degree programs, student stories, training classes, and insights on success from many career fields.

## Information for Online Students

- [Find Your Place As A Razorback](https://online.uark.edu/students/): The flexibility of online learning empowers you to find your place at the University of Arkansas no matter where you work and live.
- [Online Student Success](https://online.uark.edu/students/online-student-success.php): A coach is someone that students can meet with to schedule an appointment with a coach to learn about what services are offered.
- [Online Student Liaison Office](https://online.uark.edu/students/online-student-liaison-office.php): We can help you take the right steps to navigate from application through graduation.
- [Online Student Orientation](https://online.uark.edu/students/online-orientation.php): As a University of Arkansas online student, you will join our community of passionate learners and grow from the knowledge of top faculty and instructors.
- [Estimated Costs](https://online.uark.edu/estimated-costs.php): Breakdown of tuition and fees associated with online programs.
- [Microcertificate Frequently Asked Questions](https://online.uark.edu/programs/microcertificate-frequently-asked-questions.php): Discover how online microcertificates from the University of Arkansas can boost your career. See FAQs to learn more about these credentials.

## Student Resources

- [Support for Student Success](https://online.uark.edu/resources/): As a University of Arkansas online student, you will join our community of passionate learners and grow from the knowledge of top faculty and instructors.
- [New Online Student Checklist](https://online.uark.edu/students/checklist.php): Step-by-step instructions to help you get connected with the University of Arkansas.
- [Online Transfer Credit Information](https://online.uark.edu/resources/online-transfer-credit-information.php): Are you preparing to transfer to the U of A and want to study online?
- [Online Course Readiness Quiz](https://online.uark.edu/resources/readiness-quiz.php): A quiz designed to assess readiness for online learning.
- [Transcript Ordering Service](https://online.uark.edu/resources/transcript-ordering-service.php): Transcript ordering service for University of Arkansas Online students.
- [ID Card for Online Students](https://online.uark.edu/students/id-card-online-students.php): As an online student, you can obtain a University of Arkansas student ID card, even if you cannot come to the Fayetteville campus.
- [Academic Information for Compliance and Complaints](https://online.uark.edu/resources/academic-approval.php): The University of Arkansas is authorized or exempted from authorization in the green states in the provided map for all distance programs.
- [Stay Healthy](https://online.uark.edu/students/health-services.php): Health services for University of Arkansas students in Arkansas who study exclusively online.

## W.E. Manning Memorial Scholarship

- [W.E. Manning Memorial Scholarship](https://online.uark.edu/manning-scholarship/): Offering scholarships each fall semester to students studying in U of A undergraduate and graduate online degree programs.
- [W.E. Manning Memorial Scholarship Fund](https://online.uark.edu/manning-scholarship/manning-memorial-scholarship-fund.php): The W.E. Manning Memorial Scholarship Fund is transforming lives through education.
- [About William E. Manning, Jr.](https://online.uark.edu/manning-scholarship/william-manning.php): William Ellis Manning, Jr. cared deeply about higher education.

- [20-Year Construction Coordinator Continues to Learn with Online Degree](https://online.uark.edu/blog/20-year-construction-coordinator-continues-to-learn-with-online-degree.php): "Every class, used every day. Milner has worked as a construction coordinator for Facilities Management at the U of A for 20 years. This milestone work anniversary coincides with his final day in his final class of the degree program.

Manning Memorial Scholarship winners have to say. These students are successful in a wide range of online degree programs offered by the University of Arkansas.

And, they have access to software programs through student fees they pay, just like on-campus students.
- [Advance Your Career in Speech-Language Pathology with a Post-Master's Certificate](https://online.uark.edu/blog/advance-your-career-in-speech-language-pathology-with-a-post-masters-certificate.php): A career in speech-language pathology is dynamic and fulfilling. - [Agricultural and Food Law Students Explore Critical Emerging Issues](https://online.uark.edu/blog/agricultural-and-food-law-students-explore-critical-emerging-issues.php): The overlapping food and agriculture industries have long confronted challenges in meeting the needs of markets and consumers. They face the growing complexity of global supply chains amid calls for greater transparency and enhanced safety assurances. Climate change causes new disruptions. Issues about our food system are in the news almost daily.
- [AI Prompts Global Campus Staff to Offer Knowledge of Tools](https://online.uark.edu/blog/ai-prompts-global-campus-staff-offer-knowledge-of-tools.php): Global Campus staff don't need to be prompted to put artificial intelligence tools at the top of the list when they offer guidance to instructors who teach online. No hallucinating here as teams of University of Arkansas instructors and Global Campus staff work together to create effective learning experiences for students. The Global Campus instructional designers, learning technology specialists, media production staff, faculty support specialist and faculty support coordinator work one-on-one with instructors as well as presenting group sessions and offering the annual BOLT conference, which stands for Better Online Learning Together, in October.

Whether it is the loss of a loved one, the arrival of a child, or the pivot of a career path, these moments can upend our lives, leaving us feeling out of control and often helpless. In moments such as these, when our whole world is jolted, the unknown lingers over us, creating a new reality of uncertainty and stress. In 2020, the whole world felt the harsh jolt of COVID-19 as the pandemic raged from country to country. The abrupt change in lifestyles, daily routines, jobs, and even personal connections drastically affected everyone, leaving each person to cope with the stress these changes created. While some did this by exercising or finding a new hobby, others refused to acknowledge the toll this jolt took on their mental health and well-being. Coping mechanisms differed from person to person, creating a specific coping profile for everyone.
